title: Ryven's Retro Mania
description: A lightweight retro-style Fabric modpack with classic textures and modern performance.
body:
## 📼 Ryven’s Retro Mania

Ryven’s Retro Mania is a lightweight **retro-styled Fabric modpack** designed to bring back the feeling of classic Minecraft while keeping the game smooth and modern.

With nostalgic textures from **Golden Days Alpha**, performance-boosting optimization mods, and customizable visuals, this pack creates a clean, old-school Minecraft experience that still runs fast on modern PCs.

Whether you're exploring caves, building massive worlds, or just enjoying the classic atmosphere, this pack keeps Minecraft **simple, nostalgic, and smooth**.

### ✨ Features

• Classic **Alpha-style textures** and retro visuals
• **High performance** with modern optimization mods
• Clean and lightweight — no unnecessary content
• Built for **Fabric 1.21.11**
• Perfect for players who want **classic Minecraft vibes with modern FPS**

### ⚡ Included Improvements

• Performance boosts for smoother gameplay
• Better rendering and entity performance
• Configurable settings and customization

If you miss the **simple charm of early Minecraft**, this pack brings that nostalgic feeling back while keeping everything **fast, stable, and modern**.

**Ryven’s Retro Mania — Classic vibes. Smooth performance.**
